english.title: Furnish rule 6A certificate to returning officer knowing candidate is standing elsewhere
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of corrupt practice in that you caused or permitted a certificate authorising for the purposes of rule 6A of the parliamentary elections rules the use by a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at a

(A)_[parliamentary]_
(B)_[local government]_

election of a description knowing that the candidate was standing at an election in another constituency in which the poll was to be held on the same day as the poll at the election to which the certificate related
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 65A(1)(c) and 168(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
